assertions.name: covariance_epic_A2_polynomial_positivity_reduction
assertions.source: A2 reduced to R(x)>=0 on (0,1) via P(x)=x(x-1)R(x); R>0 on [0,inf) (all real roots negative) verified n<=15; moment tower M_1..M_8>0, M_2=|C3|; three easy-proof certificates (single-crossing nu / cumulative S_v<=0 / R nonneg coeffs) all FALSE. Sharpening, not a proof. No fit; no c_k.

description: Attack A2 advance (qou-x631): reduce Cov_Planch(ln f^λ,ω₃)≤0 to an EXACT polynomial positivity, and close three natural easy-proof routes. With ν_v=Cov_Planch(N_v,ω₃) (N_v=#hooks of length v) and the hook-covariance generating polynomial P(x)=Σ_v ν_v x^v: P(0)=P(1)=0 (ΣN_v=n const), Cov(H_s,ω₃)=P(e^{−s}), so Cov(H_s,ω₃)≤0 ∀s>0 ⟺ P≤0 on (0,1); factoring P(x)=x(x−1)R(x) (deg R=n−2), and x(x−1)<0 on (0,1), gives A2 ⟸ R(x)≥0 on (0,1). VERIFIED (n≤15): R≥0 on (0,1) and in fact R has NO positive real root (R>0 on [0,∞), real roots all negative). Moment tower M_k=Σv^k ν_v=Cov(Σh^k,ω₃): M_0=0, M_2=|C₃|=n(n−1)(n−2)/3 (via Σh²=Σc²+n²), M_1..M_8>0. THREE easy-proof certificates are FALSE, so the negativity is a genuine polynomial-positivity fact, not total-positivity: (a) ν is NOT single-signed-crossing (oscillates, up to 7 changes by n=14) — Karlin variation-diminishing fails; (b) the cumulative S_v=Σ_{u≤v}ν_u are NOT all ≤0 (first fails n=6, S_2=+1) — Abel-summation cert fails; (c) R does NOT have all-nonneg coefficients (fails n=6,8,10,…) — positive-coeff cert fails. SHARPENS A2 to a concrete polynomial statement (R has no nonnegative real root) and tells the next attempt what will NOT work. Does NOT prove the kernel. scope-(a); no fit; nothing wired; no c_k; L2 2/7.

data.reduction: A2 (Cov(ln f,omega3)<=0) <== R(x)>=0 on (0,1), P(x)=Sum nu_v x^v=x(x-1)R(x)
data.open_subtarget: prove R(x) has no nonnegative real root for general n
